Usage:  container run <image> <command>

RunContainerRun runs a command in a new container.

Options:
  image            Image to run. (string)
  command          Command and arguments to execute. ([]string)
  --[no-]detach    Run container in background and print container ID. (bool, default: false)
  --env            Set environment variables. ([]string)
  --env-file       Read in a file of environment variables. ([]string, labels: path=exists, path=file)
  --[no-]interactive Keep STDIN open even if not attached. (bool, default: false)
  --name           Assign a name to the container. (string)
  --publish        Publish a container's port to the host. ([]string)
  --[no-]rm        Automatically remove the container when it exits. (bool, default: false)
  --pull           Pull image before running. (string, default: missing, choices: always, missing, never)
  --[no-]tty       Allocate a pseudo-TTY. (bool, default: false)
  --volume         Bind mount a volume. ([]string)
  --workdir        Working directory inside the container. (string)

Options (global):
  --api-version    Set the API version to use. (string)
  --config         Location of client configuration files. (string, labels: path=clean)
  --[no-]debug     Enable debug mode. (bool, default: false)
  --host           Daemon socket to connect to. ([]string, default: unix:///var/run/docker.sock)
  --[no-]tls       Use TLS. (bool, default: false)
  --tlscacert      Trust certs signed only by this CA. (string, labels: path=file, path=clean)
